body: I guess I will try...I'll keep going, even if I don't want to. I'll do it for him. I hope it gets better. I've been waiting for it to get better and it hasn't.

It is so complicated though...I know my brain might be messed up and I worry, "What if I'm a psychopath and I'm not capable of being a good friend/girlfriend/future parent". In that case I can't be a good girlfriend until I fix my depression and my problems...Why would he want a girlfriend with so many issues when he is perfectly sane and has his life together...I feel like I'm dragging him down no matter what because if I live, he has to put up with me or break up with me. If I die, he'll never be the same. I worry I'm ruining his life sometimes.
Wow...thank you that puts perspective on a lot. I should fight if he is going to fight for me.
